card.name: The word of after absorption
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after "absorption" or "supplements" when fat-soluble vitamins or dietary fats come next. It also fires on "fat" in "fat-soluble".

modes.label: Absorption of
modes.description: The word "of" after absorption, just before fat-soluble vitamins.
modes.example: may prevent absorption<< of>> fat-soluble vitamins such as A

modes.description: The word "fat" just before "-soluble vitamins" after absorption of.
